releases.name: v1.1.10
releases.body:
- Your ship now becomes entangled while at a certain location, making it easier to return to it
- Added Russian translation (Thanks HanSoloCh!)
- Small tweaks to the Chinese (Simplified) translation (Thanks SanBaiMing!)
releases.bodyZh:
- 在特定位置时，您的飞船会进入纠缠状态，使其更容易返回
- 添加了俄语翻译（感谢 HanSoloCh！）
- 对中文（简体）翻译进行了小调整（感谢 SanBaiMing！）

releases.name: v1.1.9
releases.body: - Fixed accidental misgendering of a vanilla character
releases.bodyZh: - 修复了某个原版角色意外性别错误

releases.name: v1.1.8
releases.body: * Update Chinese (Simplified) translation to clarify an important character's name, among multiple other improvements (thanks SanBaiMing!)
releases.bodyZh: * 将简体中文翻译更新，以澄清一个重要角色的名字，以及其他多项改进（感谢SanBaiMing！）

releases.name: v1.1.7
releases.body:
- By popular demand, added workarounds to get full compatibility with Pick Up Chert
- Updated Chinese (Simplified) translation (Thanks SanBaiMing!)
releases.bodyZh:
- 应广大需求，添加了与Pick Up Chert完全兼容的解决方案
- 更新了简体中文翻译（感谢三百万！）

releases.name: v1.1.6
releases.body:
- Added achievements! Install the Achievements+ mod to enable them.
- Fixed the trigger for the bad ending persisting after reloading from credits
releases.bodyZh:
- 添加了成就！安装 Achievements+ 模组以启用它们。
- 修复了在从信用画面重新加载后持续触发的坏结局触发器。

releases.name: v1.1.5
releases.body:
Final jam submission version (unless an urgent hotfix is needed).

- Slightly extended a tight time limit in a later part of the mod
- Reverted previous change that showed confusing "does not fit" messages in some circumstances
- Fixed certain ship log facts being revealed prematurely when read
- Item sockets on certain devices that are already visually occupied have been disabled
- Various devices and characters now visually and textually reflect the current state of their linked devices
- Tweaked some wording to gloss over a continuity issue

releases.name: v1.1.4
releases.body:
- Chinese (Simplified) translation (thanks SanBaiMing!)
- Added new ship log entries describing the core progression mechanic
- Improved visual clarity of an item in the starting area
- Added on-screen messages for the player if they're missing an important item or holding the wrong item
- Added a fallback if the player forgot the item while traveling to an early location
- Fixed the physics on a tractor beam that was difficult to enter
- Fixed certain objects rotating the wrong way when activated
- Fixed some device-related sound effects not playing correctly
- Minor tweaks and fixes

releases.name: v1.1.2
releases.body:
- Added a new visual and audible cue when certain devices are activated or deactivated
- Fixed a soft crash when playing on a fresh profile. It now alters the save state to resemble a third-loop save file if the launch codes are not yet acquired
- Minor fixes for log error spam

releases.name: v1.1.1
releases.body: - Removed early spoilers for a character's identity
